summary: Smoke-tested Rekapin HR Recruitment app end-to-end. Backend auth, CRUD, stats and Excel export all green. Frontend login (invalid+valid), candidate add, auto-filter to Interview tab, row-level Blacklist with prompt + auto-move to Blacklist tab, delete, logout and route guard all work. Only anomaly: 4 of 5 stat cards' data-testid is_visible returned False right after dashboard load (stat-blacklist=True) — likely animation/timing, non-blocking.
passed: POST /api/auth/login with valid admin creds returns access_token
POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401 and Indonesian error
Login page renders and invalid password shows error
All 5 tabs and action buttons (add, export, search, logout) visible
Add candidate flow saves and row appears in Master Data tab
Candidate with status_interview='Sudah Dipanggil' AUTOMATICALLY appears in Interview tab (key feature)
Row-level Blacklist action: prompt accepted with reason, candidate moved to Blacklist tab automatically
Delete candidate removes row from listing
Logout clears session and redirects to /login
Direct visit /dashboard without token redirects to /login

failed.issue: data-testid=stat-total, stat-interview, stat-training, stat-placement reported not visible by Playwright right after dashboard mount (stat-blacklist visible). Could be render/animation timing, not verified as broken visually.
failed.evidence: is_visible checks returned False for 4/5 stat cards while stat-blacklist=True in same tick

action_items: Optional: verify stat cards render synchronously (or wrap in Playwright wait_for). Not blocking first finish.
